sourcePageBasis: capture sequence, checked against surrounding folios
paragraphs: Early position limpers create a weird dynamic in splashy games. They’re all still terrible players, but some of them have adapted by limp-raising with big hands to squeeze out the raiser and all the flatters behind. | recommend using Snowie's suggestions if you suspect the early position limpers are plotting against you.

Against everyone else, you should be isolating with the majority of your opening range from each position. Resist the urge to over-limp with so many players behind you. Again, the worst thing you can do is expose yourself to being isolated, out of position, with a capped range.
